projectAndScope: A general-reader book and companion learning journey about turning heat warnings into public protection

programmeThesisLink.approvalEvidence: The author approved the programme thesis and this linked book foundation on 2026-09-04.
programmeThesisLink.recognisedProblem: A city can measure dangerous heat accurately while responsibility for changing work, transport, shelter, and care remains fragmented.
programmeThesisLink.promisedLearnerChange: Readers leave able to trace one heat warning into a bounded public commitment with named responsibilities, thresholds, and feedback.
programmeThesisLink.centralQuestion: What must happen between a reliable warning and protection that reaches the people exposed?
programmeThesisLink.distinctiveArgument: The decisive public capacity is not prediction alone but the arrangement that converts a forecast into coordinated, revisable commitments.
programmeThesisLink.argumentBoundary: The book explains the path from warning to public action and does not offer clinical advice or claim one plan fits every city.
antiGoals: technical forecasting presented as complete public action

proposition.bookReader: General readers and civic practitioners with no assumed background in climate science or public administration
proposition.participantAudience: Civic leaders and practitioners using the companion learning journey
proposition.assumedKnowledgeBySurface: The book assumes only ordinary experience of hot weather; teaching may draw on participants' knowledge of local services.
proposition.recognisedProblem: A city can measure dangerous heat accurately while responsibility for changing work, transport, shelter, and care remains fragmented.
proposition.promisedChange: Readers leave able to trace one heat warning into a bounded public commitment with named responsibilities, thresholds, and feedback.
proposition.centralQuestion: What must happen between a reliable warning and protection that reaches the people exposed?
proposition.centralArgument: The decisive public capacity is not prediction alone but the arrangement that converts a forecast into coordinated, revisable commitments.
proposition.boundary: The book explains the path from warning to public action and does not offer clinical advice or claim one plan fits every city.
proposition.evidenceBase: Verified public-health and civic sources, clearly bounded cases, and author synthesis identified as synthesis

architecture.carriedQuestionOrArtifact: A Warning to Protection Map revised across the book
architecture.sectionLogic: Read the warning, trace the response, and write a revisable public commitment
architecture.chapterPromises: Each chapter resolves one break between measured hazard and public protection, then hands forward a harder coordination question.
architecture.openingMode: A verified heat event introduced through a concrete public decision and enough context for a novice reader
architecture.programmeTablePlacement: Interactive companion shell only; omitted from the public book reading flow

titleSystems.name: After the Warning
titleSystems.title: After the Warning
titleSystems.subtitle: How Cities Turn Heat Forecasts into Public Protection
titleSystems.promise: Names the unresolved work that begins when a technically sound warning has already been issued.
titleSystems.tradeOff: Clear and human, though the subtitle must carry the heat-specific category.
titleSystems.coverConnection: A warning line continues beyond a forecast boundary into several coordinated civic actions.

titleSystems.name: The Degrees Between Us
titleSystems.title: The Degrees Between Us
titleSystems.subtitle: Heat, Responsibility, and the Design of Public Action
titleSystems.promise: Connects physical temperature with the institutional distance between information and protection.
titleSystems.tradeOff: More literary and distinctive, but less immediately explicit about the practical method.
titleSystems.coverConnection: Measured heat bands intersect an incomplete map of shelters, transport, work, and care.

authorAndFrontMatter.authorNoteJob: Explain the author's vantage and why reliable warnings still leave a public design problem.
authorAndFrontMatter.sourceBoundary: No biography, thanks, endorsement, institution, or link is inferred from the programme thesis.

positiveMechanics: frameworks introduced after the practical problem
voiceContract.paragraphMovement: Each paragraph changes what the reader can explain about the path from warning to protection.
voiceContract.exampleStandard: One sustained verified case and only bounded lateral examples that expose a different dependency.
voiceContract.densityAndHumour: Substantive and direct, with no levity that diminishes human exposure or public responsibility.
voiceContract.vocabularyPolicy: Introduce technical and civic terms through the decision they alter, define them plainly, and reuse them in consequence.
voiceContract.emphasisPolicy: Book prose may use sparse semantic italics after a term or question has earned attention.

directions.name: Warning Line
directions.premiseConnection: Shows a forecast continuing into public decisions rather than ending at publication.
directions.composition: One measured line crosses a quiet field and branches into a sparse civic route.
directions.paletteRoles: Warm paper ground, dark civic ink, one controlled heat signal colour.
directions.typographyMood: Editorial serif paired with restrained map annotations.
directions.figureGrammar: Thresholds, handoffs, and feedback paths drawn as plain causal relations.
directions.prohibitedMotifs: Burning globes, alarm icons, generic skylines, and dashboard mosaics.
directions.differenceFromRecentWork: A continuous public route rather than a centred emblem or technology object.

directions.name: Exposure Ledger
directions.premiseConnection: Makes the gap between measured temperature and protected people visible.
directions.composition: A spare ledger pairs heat observations with the public actions still missing.
directions.paletteRoles: Off-white ground, near-black typography, rust and blue marks with distinct evidentiary jobs.
directions.typographyMood: Archival public-record typography with contemporary spacing.
directions.figureGrammar: Records, omissions, and annotations tied to their source or responsible institution.
directions.prohibitedMotifs: Stock photography, neon gradients, crowded cards, and decorative thermometers.
directions.differenceFromRecentWork: An evidence object rather than a path-led or illustrated-scene cover.

exerciseDirection.caseMode: A bounded public-warning case followed by transfer to the reader's own locality
exerciseDirection.observableArtifact: A Warning to Protection Map with comparable decision fields
exerciseDirection.commitmentRule: The reader completes the relevant map fields before a consequence or worked comparison appears.
exerciseDirection.revealRule: A consequential condition becomes available only after the reader records an initial public response.
exerciseDirection.workedComparisonJob: Show one defensible completed map field by field without claiming it is a universal city plan.

approval.evidence: Explicit approval recorded alongside the linked Programme Thesis Record
